Lionel Messi's Instagram Post Sparks 'GOAT' Debate Discussion

Argentine footballer Lionel Messi posted an Instagram story featuring a compilation of his career achievements, presented in a receipt-style format. This post followed his recent announcement of retirement from international football. The content of the post has led to discussions and speculation among fans and media outlets about whether Messi considers himself the 'Greatest Of All Time' (GOAT).
